messages:
maya: quick heads-up: prepping a docs PR for the Optimize toolkit migration guide (batching -> continuous, cache + quant profiles). need a reviewer and a runnable SDK snippet. /cc @ben @sam
ben: happy to review. can you outline the sections you plan to add?
maya: plan: 1) why continuous batching, 2) config examples, 3) cache pitfalls, 4) quant profile recommendations, 5) migration checklist + tests. aiming for a short runnable Python SDK snippet first.
sam: I can drop a python snippet. do you want a js version too or we add later?
maya: python first, js optional follow-up. target SDK v0.8 and keep it copy-pastable.
sam: ```python
# SDK v0.8 example - continuous batching + cache + quant profile
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
resp = client.generate(
  model="optimize/latency-tuned-v1",
  input="Summarize the last 3 messages.",
  batching={"mode": "continuous", "max_batch_tokens": 1024, "batch_window_ms": 25},
  cache={"enable_prefix_kv": True, "ttl_seconds": 600},
  quant_profile="balanced-8bit"
)
print(resp.text)
```
leo: runtime note: continuous batching + KV cache may need a warmup for long conversations. add a note about prefill/priming to avoid cold-start token penalty.
maya: good call — i'll add a short 'warmup' example and suggested priming command.
jen: qa request: add a docs-ci snippet test so we catch snippet regressions on deploy.
maya: added a docs-ci job in the branch, but noticed the TOC link to the batching anchor is wrong: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize#batching-config should be /optimize/batching#continuous — @ben can you patch the TOC?
ben: on it, pushing a quick patch to fix the anchor.
docs-bot: CI | docs-pr-4721: build failed - linkchecker: broken link in docs/optimize/index.md: /optimize#batching-config
ben: fixed the anchor and re-ran the linkchecker.
docs-bot: CI | docs-pr-4721: build passed ✅
eli: product ask: add one short blurb recommending an automatic fallback to a smaller quant profile when under high contention to preserve latency SLAs.
maya: added fallback recommendations and a compact quant-profile table (latency vs quality) plus an example policy snippet. ready for review @ben @sam
ben: reviewed, left two tiny wording comments and an inline suggestion about the example values. :thumbsup:
maya: addressed comments and updated the snippet. merging now. final doc URL: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/migration/continuous-batching
docs-bot: Docs | PR #4721 merged by maya
